svg.text: The layers of solprop, and every module in each
Bands and colours from architecture.md §3 and decisions.md ADR-001; modules from src/solprop. Arrows point from the layer that imports to the layer it imports.
numpy; the native package in native/; S
S → P the grids, modes and profiles a statistic reads
T → S the run request: stepper settings, statistics, field retention
B → T delta_phi, prefactor_at, the stage bundle
D → B backends.select, then the seam
X → D a saved run, through the Output protocol
1 physics objects become the kernel problem
2 the request's settings, the statistics catalogue and the record types a session writes
4 the driver builds the grid, the modes, the pulse and the responses
5 the statistics path: a backend is handed grid, modes and profiles at construction: the one import of P that architecture.md §3 allows B, types and constants, never a physics object
6 processing.modal takes the run's own ModalTransformTables beside the handler: a general modal file records what its reference is and not the arrays, so the reference is rebuilt in T and read in X
The package-wide modules carry no layer letter: __init__.py · exceptions.py · log.py
